rule: Exclusions use the same relevance, authority, coverage, redundancy, and claim-level-value criteria as retentions. Exclusion at title/abstract stage does not assert that an unavailable full work lacks quality; it asserts that it was not needed for this locked lane corpus.

exclusions.title: Efficient Adaptive-Support Association Rule Mining for Recommender Systems
exclusions.reason: Directly relevant but redundant after retaining the foundational Apriori source and the stronger direct multi-item rule-recommendation study.

exclusions.title: On Scalability of Association-rule-based Recommendation: A Unified Distributed-computing Framework
exclusions.reason: Primarily a distributed scaling/serving study; no necessary claim-level value for the locked mechanism or attribution questions.

exclusions.title: ReCANet: A Repeat Consumption-Aware Neural Network for Next Basket Recommendation in Grocery Shopping
exclusions.reason: Explicit repeat-consumption focus conflicts with the locked novel-purchase target and is redundant as counter-evidence after retaining the Reality Check and repetition/exploration studies.

exclusions.title: Learning to Ride a Buy-Cycle: A Hyper-Convolutional Model for Next Basket Recommendation
exclusions.reason: Buy-cycle/repurchase focus is not a direct baseline for organic novel purchase; no unique retained claim card.

exclusions.title: Turning Dross Into Gold Loss: Is BERT4Rec Really Better than SASRec?
exclusions.reason: Replaced with Petrov and Macdonald's broader systematic review and replicability study of BERT4Rec, which has a lawful inspected full artifact and stronger coverage of training-budget and implementation sensitivity.

exclusions.title: On Sampled Metrics for Item Recommendation
exclusions.reason: General metric-evaluation source belongs to the evaluation lane. L3 carries the no-metric-transplant restriction without duplicating the corpus record.

exclusions.title: Towards Generic and Efficient Recommendation for Next Basket Recommendation
exclusions.reason: Additional direct NBR model, but no unique association-rule, sequential-objective, repeat/explore, or attribution claim remained after the retained direct baselines. Canonical details were not promoted because the work was excluded at abstract screening.

exclusions.title: Time-Aware Item Weighting for Next Basket Recommendations
exclusions.reason: Adds a temporal weighting model but not a necessary source for the locked association-rule or hybrid-attribution claims; current protocol coverage is supplied by Time to Split.

exclusions.title: ReALM: A Recommender System for Next-Basket Prediction
exclusions.reason: RecSys short contribution/poster with no unique claim-level coverage beyond retained full papers.

exclusions.title: Recommendations Using Information from Multiple Association Rules: A Probabilistic Approach
exclusions.reason: Relevant extension but redundant for the bounded association-rule recommendation claim after retaining the 2014 direct multi-item study.

exclusions.title: Revisiting BERT4Rec: A Replicability and Performance Reassessment
exclusions.reason: Preprint-only and redundant after retaining the peer-reviewed Petrov and Macdonald systematic review/replication paper.

exclusions.title: An Improved Loss for BERT4Rec Sequential Recommendation
exclusions.reason: Loss variant does not add necessary canonical objective or reproducibility coverage beyond BERT4Rec and the retained replication study.

exclusions.title: Repeat-bias-aware Optimization of Beyond-accuracy Metrics for Next Basket Recommendation
exclusions.reason: Valuable beyond-accuracy post-processing work, but fairness/diversity optimization is outside the locked L3 estimand; repeat-bias evidence is already covered by retained primary sources.

exclusions.title: Beyond-Accuracy Evaluation for Next Basket Recommendation
exclusions.reason: Focuses on beyond-accuracy objectives rather than the locked association-rule/hybrid estimand; excluded without a production claim.

exclusions.title: SAFERec: A Framework for Next Basket Recommendation
exclusions.reason: Preprint model does not supply unique locked-lane claim coverage beyond peer-reviewed direct basket sources.

exclusions.title: A Reproducibility Study of TIFU-KNN for Next Basket Recommendation
exclusions.reason: Useful reproduction but TIFU-KNN is not a required direct baseline for this lane and the work adds no unique rule/hybrid claim card.

exclusions.title: Time-Interval-Aware Disentangled Expert Modeling for Next-Basket Recommendation
exclusions.reason: Current and relevant, but preprint-only at cutoff and redundant for repeat/explore hybrid claims after retaining the peer-reviewed 2026 publisher article with component ablations.

exclusions.title: CASE: Cadence-Aware Set Encoding for Large-Scale Next Basket Repurchase Recommendation
exclusions.reason: Explicit repurchase target conflicts with the locked novel-purchase focus; retained repeat/explore sources already cover repurchase dominance as counter-evidence.

access_failures_not_misclassified_as_abs.detail: Eight DOI requests failed with an underlying TLS connection closure. Official publisher, proceedings, institutional, and full-artifact records were used instead.
Direct HTML open returned HTTP 429. The official publisher PDF was lawfully acquired from the MDPI asset host and inspected; this was never classified as unmatched.

access_failures_not_misclassified_as_abs.system: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University repository local download
access_failures_not_misclassified_as_abs.detail: The 2007 full PDF was inspectable through the research browser but local download failed certificate validation. Validation was not bypassed.

access_failures_not_misclassified_as_abs.system: University of Amsterdam author PDF local download
access_failures_not_misclassified_as_abs.detail: The repetition/exploration paper was inspected remotely; local TLS issuer validation failed and was not bypassed.
Browser automation initialization failed with a local EPERM filesystem error; ordinary web research and lawful Python HTTPS acquisition were used.
